features.name: spectral_energy_sum
features.description: Sum of all five spectral coefficients representing total spectral energy across frequency bands
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures overall spectral magnitude which may differ systematically between phoneme groups

features.name: spectral_peak_value
features.description: Maximum spectral coefficient value across all five bands indicating dominant frequency component
features.expected_model_benefit: Peak spectral energy is a strong discriminator for phoneme classification trees to split on

features.name: spectral_range
features.description: Difference between maximum and minimum spectral coefficients measuring spectral spread
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral spread distinguishes phonemes with concentrated vs distributed frequency energy
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5)

features.name: low_freq_to_high_freq_ratio
features.description: Ratio of low frequency bands (V1+V2) to high frequency bands (V4+V5) capturing spectral tilt
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral tilt ratio provides nonlinear interaction between frequency bands useful for tree splits

features.name: mid_band_dominance
features.description: Whether V3 (mid-frequency band) exceeds the mean of V1 and V5 (edge bands), indicating mid-frequency dominance
features.expected_model_benefit: Boolean split on mid-frequency dominance creates direct threshold for tree models

features.name: spectral_gradient_v1_v5
features.description: Linear slope from V1 to V5 measuring spectral trend direction across frequency bands
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral slope direction and magnitude helps trees identify rising vs falling spectral patterns

features.name: v2_v3_interaction
features.description: Product of V2 and V3 capturing nonlinear interaction between adjacent mid-frequency bands
features.expected_model_benefit: Multiplicative interaction creates curved decision boundaries that tree ensembles can approximate with splits

features.name: high_energy_band_count
features.description: Count of spectral bands exceeding value 1.0 indicating number of high-energy frequency components
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal count of high-energy bands provides natural tree splits at integer thresholds

features.name: spectral_variance_proxy
features.description: Variance proxy computed as mean squared deviation of each band from their collective mean
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral variance captures uniformity vs peakedness of frequency distribution for tree splitting

features.name: v1_negative_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for negative V1 values which may signal atypical low-frequency spectral behavior
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct boolean split on V1 sign provides a simple but potentially powerful tree node

features.name: spectral_energy_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket (0-3) representing overall spectral energy level: 0=very low (sum<0), 1=low (0 to 2), 2=medium (2 to 5), 3=high (sum>=5)
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretized energy level creates clean categorical splits for tree models without numeric noise

features.name: spectral_shape_type
features.description: Categorical shape encoding: 0=monotone decreasing (V1>V2>V3>V4>V5), 1=monotone increasing (V1<V2<V3<V4<V5), 2=peaked in middle (V3 is max), 3=other irregular shape
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral shape type groups phonemes by frequency profile pattern enabling categorical splits in trees
